articles.summary: The transaction marks Equinor’s entry into Namibia and the licence provides access to a drill-ready prospect scheduled for testing in 2026.
articles.title: Equinor joins Chevron in Namibia exploration licence

articles.summary: Equinor, Aker BP and Vår Energi are establishing a strategic exploration collaboration to pursue some of the largest remaining opportunities on the NCS.
articles.title: Equinor, Aker BP and Vår Energi join forces to search for Norway’s next major discoveries

articles.summary: The Troll A platform in the North Sea is being supplied with additional gas. On 22 August production started from the Troll Phase 3 stage 2 subsea project.
articles.title: More gas for 30-year-old Troll A

articles.summary: Equinor has agreed to acquire an interest in the Lackawanna Energy Center (Lackawanna), a 1,483 MW gas-fired combined cycle power plant (CCGT) in Pennsylvania.
articles.title: Equinor strengthens position in US power market

articles.summary: “Equinor’s international oil and gas portfolio is simplified, improved and set for significant growth,” says executive vice president Philippe Mathieu.
articles.title: Fewer countries, higher output from reshaped international portfolio

articles.summary: The shares in Equinor will be traded on the Oslo Stock Exchange and New York Stock Exchange exclusive the first quarter 2026 cash dividend as detailed below.
articles.title: Ex. dividend first quarter 2026

articles.summary: Equinor ASA announced on 6 May 2026 a cash dividend per share of USD 0.39 for first quarter 2026.
articles.title: Announcement of cash dividend of NOK 3.6882 per share for first quarter 2026

articles.summary: Equinor and the energy company Uniper have signed a 15-year agreement for supplies of natural gas to Germany.
articles.title: Equinor and Uniper sign 15-year gas sales agreement for supplies to Germany

articles.summary: Equinor has signed an agreement with Poland’s ORLEN for the sale of crude oil from the Johan Sverdrup field on the Norwegian continental shelf.
articles.title: Equinor and ORLEN strengthen energy partnership with crude oil agreement
